items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Joe Fatali, he's been with me since last January.

ctx.x: Right. And, what do you, I mean, what could you tell us about the other members of hte group?
Joe Fatali, he's been with me since last January. I had a girl pianist before then, Delores Leacock. She's from

Panama. She got ill last December. She had been with me here 10 years. Yeah. She got one of those nervous things. So, she had to stop for awhile. So, she went back home to take care of herself. You know, with her parents.
